import re
def separate_paren_groups(paren_string: str) -> List[str]:
        paren_string = re.sub(r'(\([^)]*\))', r'\1', paren_string)
        paren_string = re.sub(r'(\(.*\))', r'\1', paren_string)
        paren_string = re.sub(r'(\{.*\})', r'\1', paren_string)
        paren_string = re.sub(r'(\[.*\])', r'\1', paren_string)
        paren_string = re.sub(r'(\w+)', r'\1', paren_string)
        paren_string = re.sub(r'(\d+)', r'\1', paren_string)
        paren_string = re.sub(r'(\s+)', '', paren_string)
        paren_string = re.sub(r'(\S+)', r'\1', paren_string)
        paren_string = re.sub(r'(\w+)\W(\w+)', r'\2\3', paren_string)
        paren_string = re.sub(r'(\w+)\W(\w+)', r'\2\3', paren_string)
        paren_string = re.sub(r'(\w+)\W(\w+)', r'\2\3', paren_string)
        paren_string = re.sub(r'(\w+)\W(\w+)', r'\2\3', paren_string)
        paren_string = re.sub(r'(\w+)\W(\w+)', r'\2\3', paren_string)
        paren_string = re.sub(r'(\w+)\W(\w+)', r'\2\3', paren_string)
        paren_string = re.sub(r'(\w+)\W(\w+)', r'\2\3', paren_string)
        paren_string = re.sub(r'(\w+)\W(\w+)', r'\2\3', paren_string)
        paren_string = re.sub(r'(\w+)\W(\w+)', r'\2\3', paren_string)

import re
def parse_music(music_string: str) -> List[int]:
    music = re.compile(r"([o|\.|\s])")
    return [int(music.search(note).group(0)) for note in music_string.split()]

def find_zero(xs: list):
    """ xs are coefficients of a polynomial.
    find_zero find x such that poly(x) = 0.
    find_zero returns only only zero point, even if there are many.
    Moreover, find_zero only takes list xs having even number of coefficients
    and largest non zero coefficient as it guarantees
    a solution.
    >>> round(find_zero([1, 2]), 2) # f(x) = 1 + 2x
    -0.5
    >>> round(find_zero([-6, 11, -6, 1]), 2) # (x - 1) * (x - 2) * (x - 3) = -6 + 11x - 6x^2 + x^3
    1.0
    """
    n = len(xs)
    if n % 2 != 0:
        raise ValueError("The length of the list must be an even number")
    else:
        return [math.pow(-1, i) / math.pow(2, i) for i in range(n // 2)]

def histogram(test):

    max_count = max(res.values())
    result = [key for key in res.keys() if res[key] == max_count]

def Strongest_Extension(class_name, extensions):
  class_name = class_name
  extensions = [x.lower() for x in extensions]
  max_strength = 0
  strongest_extension = ''
  for extension in extensions:
    count_uppercase = sum([i.isupper() for i in extension])
    count_lower = len(extension) - count_uppercase
    strength = round((count_uppercase - count_lower) / 25)
    if strength > max_strength:
      max_strength = strength
      strongest_extension = extension
  return f'{class_name}.{strongest_extension}'
